title: Design System: sintr website
scope: Public website only (site/): the home (site/index.html) and Under the hood (site/tech/index.html). The product data model is documented in docs/DESIGN.md.

display-doc.purpose: The /tech/ headline; display voice capped at 5rem.

headline-statement.purpose: Two-tone statements; second clause in Soft Ink.

headline.purpose: Home section heads; XL variant clamps up to 5rem.

title.purpose: Day headings, opened by an italic Ink Three time of day inside the sentence.

payoff.purpose: The home's closing scene line, opened by its own italic Ink Three day stamp; max 16em, balanced.

doc-heading.purpose: Section heads on /tech/, one per hairline-topped section.

step-numeral.purpose: Light serif counter of the get-started steps, in Soft Ink.

step-title.purpose: Titles of the three get-started steps.

title-small.purpose: Sub-heads, privacy promise terms (including the three-in-a-row promises), and /tech/ sub-sections.

note-value-large.purpose: Inline check-in values in a notebook card; tabular, never wrapped. Available; not on the home since revision 3.

body.purpose: Prose at max 36em in Ink Two; 1rem under 720px.

document.purpose: Serif body of the report paper.

note-value.purpose: The person's words, tasks and observations in a notebook card.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, tabs, segmented options. Sentence case.

caption.purpose: Notebook labels, contents title, fact terms, table headers, flow edges, draft status.

file-body.purpose: Contents of real files and shell commands, on /tech/ only.

file-path.purpose: Path captions of real files, on /tech/ only.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Default notebook cards and file cards resting in the light.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The hero notebook card and the report paper.

shadows.name: button-ink-rest
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow under the ink pill at rest.

shadows.name: button-ink-hover
shadows.purpose: Warm glow rising under the ink pill on hover, with a 1px lift.

shadows.name: paper-ring
shadows.purpose: Knocks gate dots out of the line they sit on (5px on the stations gate).

shadows.name: draft-dot-ring
shadows.purpose: Pale peach ring around the 7px draft status dot.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Expo-out for interface transitions, reveals and the highlighter.

motion.name: ease-slow
motion.purpose: Slow in-out for the window light.

motion.name: light-recolor
motion.purpose: Cross-fade of --l1, --l2, --l3, --leaf (registered @property colors) on time-of-day change.

motion.name: light-move
motion.purpose: The window pane travels to where the section's light falls (home only; /tech/ holds it in the header).

motion.name: light-enter-breathe
motion.value: sun-enter 2.8s; sun-breathe 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate (opacity 1 to .84)

motion.name: leaf-sway
motion.purpose: Leaf shadows move in the window light.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 1.3s, transform 1.4s (16px), filter 1.3s (blur 5px) var(--ease); stagger 0.09s, max 6
motion.purpose: Content settles in once on entering the viewport.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.value: rise 1.5s var(--ease), children delayed 0, .18s, .34s, .48s; hero card settle 1.9s at .7s

motion.name: write
motion.value: row opacity .9s, delay i*150ms + 200ms; highlighter 1.4s at 1.35s
motion.purpose: The hero notebook card, the only one on the home, writes itself row by row on load, then the quoted thought is highlighted.

motion.name: tab-underline
motion.purpose: Selected tab underline grows from the left.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: The setup message disclosure opens (the home's closed setup disclosure).

motion.name: toc-current
motion.value: color .3s var(--ease); aria-current set by IntersectionObserver
motion.purpose: The /tech/ contents list marks the section being read (enhancement only).

motion.name: parallax
motion.purpose: Artifacts drift slightly slower than the words.

motion.name: opt-in
motion.purpose: Content is visible by default; reduced motion removes animation and transitions.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: All splits single-column, sticky released, steps stack, the three promises stack with a hairline under each, contents list becomes a static two-column list, front matter pair stacks; parallax off at or below.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Body 1rem, 72px header without text links (home: Get started pill; /tech/: GitHub mark and Install pill), fixed oversized light, lists and spec rows stack.

breakpoints.name: flow-home
breakpoints.purpose: Home flow line becomes a vertical spine. Still defined; the home no longer shows the flow line.

breakpoints.name: flow-doc
breakpoints.purpose: /tech/ flow line becomes a vertical spine.

breakpoints.name: note-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Notebook card rows stack label over value.

breakpoints.name: note-inline-small
breakpoints.purpose: Inline check-in values step down to 1.1875rem.

lightTreatment.home: Fixed to the viewport with motion; recolors and moves with each section's data-time.
lightTreatment.tech: Absolute in the header (inset 0 0 auto 0, height 92vh), mask-image linear-gradient(#000 55%, transparent); held at noon, translate(2vw,-4vh) scale(1.05) rotate(-2deg), opacity .78.
lightTreatment.mobile: Under 720px one 150vw pane, rotate(-4deg), opacity .62 (.42 at night).

section.purpose: Section rest on /tech/ (and the original home rhythm).

section-home.purpose: Tighter section rest on the home since revision 3: body:not(.page-tech) { --section: clamp(88px, 10vw, 148px) }.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: The primary action: a black pill with an optional line icon; lifts with a warm glow on hover.
components.html: Copy install prompt
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { --glow: rgba(240, 190, 160, 0); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 26px 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink, #16171a); color: #fff; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: .005em; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(22, 23, 26, .2), 0 10px 26px -10px var(--glow); transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), box-shadow .8s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), background-color .4s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-btn-ink:hover { --glow: rgba(232, 168, 130, .55); background: #000; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(22, 23, 26, .2), 0 16px 30px -12px var(--glow); } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #16171a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-ico { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Serif wordmark with window glyph, quiet text links, and a small ink pill ("Get started" on the home, "Install" on /tech/).
components.html:
sintr
How it worksPrivacyUnder the hoodGet started

components.html: Report language

components.name: Get-started Steps
components.description: Three steps under ink rules: a light serif numeral, a serif title, quiet text, and an optional illustration made of the step's real action. On the home only step one carries one (the ink copy button); mini chat bubbles remain available.
components.html:
1. Copy the setup message

    It's a message for your assistant, not for you.

  2. Paste it to your assistant

    Start a conversation and paste it in.

    Please set up sintr for me…

  3. Answer a few questions

    Skip anything you'd rather not share.

    Which language should I write your notes in?

    Portuguese, please.
components.css: .ds-steps { counter-reset: step; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 40px 24px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: "Hanken Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-step { counter-increment: step; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding-top: 26px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #16171a); } .ds-step::before { content: counter(step); font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-size: 2.75rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink-soft, #82858c); margin-bottom: 18px; } .ds-step__title { margin: 0; font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.012em; } .ds-step__text { margin: 10px 0 0; color: var(--ink-3, #6b6e75); font-size: .9688rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-step__art { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; margin-top: 24px; } .ds-mini { margin: 0; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-mini--you { align-self: flex-end; background: var(--wash, #f5f4f1); border-bottom-right-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #16171a); } .ds-mini--agent { background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e6e1); border-bottom-left-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink-2, #474a51); } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.name: Setup Card
components.description: The morning-wash call to act, at most one per page and currently on /tech/ only: a heading, an ink Copy pill, and the message (the lead-plus-closed-disclosure form is defined but unused). The home uses the Setup Disclosure instead.
components.html:
The setup message

A message for your assistant, not for you.

Read the message before you copy it
Please set up sintr for me. It's a private journal for therapy that you'll keep for me as files on this computer.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Consulting-Room Wall"**

The page is the white wall of a quiet consulting room, and window light crosses it while the week between two sessions goes by. The ground is plaster white, everything structural is graphite ink and hairline, and the only color in the world is light: a tall, obliquely projected window of soft gradient with blurred sage leaf shadows, multiplied onto the page. On the home, as the reader moves through the week, the light changes time of day (morning, noon, dusk, evening, night, late morning, dawn) and cross-fades rather than jumps; the early-morning and golden-hour palettes stay defined for future sections. On `/tech/` the same light is held at noon in the header and fades out before the reading starts.

Hierarchy is carried by type size and line breaks alone. A light, optically sized serif speaks at display size in two tones; a quiet grotesk does the reading. The two pages share every token and face but show the product in two registers. The home demonstrates it as a person lives it, one mock per idea: a single **notebook card** in the hero (white paper with faint school-paper rules and a peach margin line, human labels in the sans and the person's own words in the serif) that writes itself on load, then a conversation in chat bubbles and the report as a sheet of paper. `/tech/` demonstrates it as it is built: real sintr file formats set as selectable Fragment Mono text in white cards captioned by their path, beside specification tables and numbered pipeline steps. The mono face lives on `/tech/` only.

Density is low and the pace is slow. Sections are separated by large vertical rests and single hairlines, not by fills or boxes. Motion is opt-in and unhurried: the light moves over about three seconds, leaves sway on 13 and 17 second cycles, and content settles in with a short blur-to-sharp fade. With JavaScript off or reduced motion requested, the light rests at the top of the page and everything reads. The wellness-app default (pastel blob hero, phone mockup, feature-card trio), the developer-tool default (dark terminal page, install commands up front) and developer-portal chrome are all rejected.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, graphite ink, black pill controls; light is the only color, echoed faintly on paper.
Light serif display (weight 300) carrying hierarchy by size and two tones, never by labels.
Two registers of artifact: the notebook card on the home (sans labels, serif words; one per page, in the hero), real file cards in mono on `/tech/`.
Hairline-ruled structure on a 12-column grid with generous section rests.
A time-of-day light that moves with the reader on the home, stays in the header on the reading page, and disappears into a static wash when motion is unwelcome.

rules.name: The Light Is the Only Color Rule
rules.body: Chroma lives in the window light. On paper it appears only as the light's own faint echoes: the peach highlighter, the notebook's sky rules and peach margin, and the draft dot. Gradients never fill text, buttons or cards; the light is a projection on the wall, multiplied onto whatever it falls across.

rules.name: The Morning Wash Exception
rules.body: At most one surface per page carries a faint light gradient as a fill: the setup-message card that asks the visitor to act (162deg, #e9f2f8 to #f3f2ee to #f9ebe1). Today that card lives on `/tech/` only ("The setup message from the home page"). The home no longer uses the exception: its setup message sits on plain Wash with a hairline inside a closed disclosure, so on the home the window light is the only color apart from the highlighter and the paper's faint echoes.

rules.name: The Verbatim Rule
rules.body: Peach highlights a person's own words. If the words are not a quotation of the person, they do not get the highlighter.

rules.name: The Size Is the Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Rank is expressed by size, weight 300 serif, and line breaks. No eyebrows, kickers, uppercase labels or icon tiles introduce a heading; context belongs inside the heading sentence.

rules.name: The Mono Means File Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono appears only on `/tech/`, for real file contents, paths, and shell commands. It never decorates a heading or signals "technical". The home shows no mono and no paths; its one piece of technical text, the setup message for the assistant, is set in the grotesk inside a disclosure that starts closed.

rules.name: The Labels Sans, Words Serif Rule
rules.body: In a notebook card, what the system asks is in the small grotesk (Ink Three); what the person said or did is in the serif (ink). The pairing is how the card reads as a person's notebook rather than a form.

rules.name: The Held Wall Rule
rules.body: The first viewport keeps one wall region empty so the light has somewhere to land. Do not fill the upper right of the hero.

rules.name: The Light Stays in the Header Rule
rules.body: On a reading page the light never sits behind long text: it is absolute in the first 92vh, masked to fade out from 55% down, and does not follow the reader.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A new surface gets a 1px hairline before it gets a shadow. Shadows are reserved for real artifacts resting in the light; the folder variant of the notebook card deliberately drops its shadow, the home's setup message sits on Wash with a hairline and no shadow, and the reading page's tables and lists are hairline only.

dos: **Do** keep every filled control Graphite Ink on white, as a full pill; selected states are ink too.
**Do** show the product on the home with one mock per idea; when it is a notebook card, put human labels in the sans and the person's words in the serif, on sky rules with a peach margin.
**Do** show real file formats on `/tech/` as selectable mono text in a white, hairline-edged card captioned with the file's path.
**Do** carry hierarchy with light serif size steps and line breaks, putting context (like the time of day) inside the heading sentence.
**Do** keep small text at Ink Three (#6b6e75) or darker; reserve Soft Ink for large type and marks.
**Do** separate sections with large rests and a single hairline rather than fills.
**Do** keep the light out from behind long reading: in the header, masked away, on any reading page.
**Do** make motion opt-in and keep every interaction (toggles, tabs, disclosures) working with JavaScript off.
**Do** self-host every font and asset; the site loads nothing from third parties.
donts: **Don't** fill text, buttons or cards with gradient; chroma belongs to the window light (including the small window in the brand glyph), its faint echoes on paper, and at most one morning-wash setup card per page (currently on `/tech/` only).
**Don't** add eyebrows, kickers, uppercase labels, or icon tiles above headings.
**Don't** use the mono face on the home, or anywhere outside real file contents, paths and commands on `/tech/`.
**Don't** use the peach highlighter on anything but a person's own quoted words.
**Don't** build the page from pastel blobs, a phone mockup, or a row of three feature cards, and don't turn it into a dark terminal page or a developer portal.

**Don't** use glassmorphism or backdrop blur on surfaces; blur belongs only to the light's soft edges, the leaf shadows, and the reveal transition. No purple-to-blue pairs; lavender appears only as evening light mixed with peach.
